caveats: Only four devices meet policy criteria for replacement based on hardware telemetry findings; six devices have healthy hardware metrics and cannot be flagged for replacement.

findings.statement: Proposed replacement under P-1 for acme-macbook-1 (MacBook Pro) due to battery health requiring service with 1049 cycles.

Proposed replacement under P-2 for acme-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) due to battery health requiring service with 1157 cycles and low storage at 3% free disk space (about 27 GB free, 5 days to full).
Proposed replacement under P-3 for acme-dell-9 (Dell XPS 15) due to battery health requiring service and memory usage averaging 94% on 16 GB RAM.
Proposed replacement under P-4 for acme-macbook-4 (MacBook Pro) due to non-upgradeable soldered storage at 2% free space (about 10 GB free, 11 days to full).
acme-macbook-2 (MacBook Pro) has normal battery health with 532 cycles, 51% free disk space (about 522 GB free), and 56% memory usage, so replacement is not warranted.
acme-thinkpad-10 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon) has normal battery health with 601 cycles, 56% free disk space (about 573 GB free), and 36% memory usage, so replacement is not warranted.
acme-mac-5 (Mac mini) has 51% free disk space (about 130 GB free) and 39% memory usage on 8 GB RAM, so replacement is not warranted.
acme-macbook-3 (MacBook Pro) has normal battery health with 411 cycles, 27% free disk space (about 275 GB free), and 37% memory usage, so replacement is not warranted.
acme-macbook-7 (MacBook Pro) has normal battery health with 592 cycles, 38% free disk space (about 194 GB free), and 32% memory usage, so replacement is not warranted.
acme-macbook-6 (MacBook Pro) has normal battery health with 212 cycles, 47% free disk space (about 243 GB free), and 55% memory usage, so replacement is not warranted.

args.summary: Proposals P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4 have been created to flag acme-macbook-1 (MacBook Pro), acme-thinkpad-8 (ThinkPad X1 Carbon), acme-dell-9 (Dell XPS 15), and acme-macbook-4 (MacBook Pro) for replacement due to active hardware findings. The remaining six devices in the fleet show healthy hardware telemetry, so policy does not permit flagging them for replacement. Cheaper component upgrade options exist for acme-macbook-1 (battery upgrade order), acme-thinkpad-8 (battery and storage upgrade orders), and acme-dell-9 (battery and RAM upgrade orders).
